comments.author: MrVibesRSA
comments.body_html: It’s a beautiful day on Ground Zero, but between me and the exfil, it’s raining lead. I’m thick as hell with the loot, and there’s no way I’m giving up—so I go to work. Don’t know if I was covered in blood or sweat, but things were heavy when the greed in me spots some poor sod I haven’t looted yet. Then, just like that—as if it was God-sent—I find a secret exfil code right next to me. I left the battlefield laughing that day.
